notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send a notification via SuperNotify to one or more notification platforms via a single, unified interface.

title.name: Title
title.description: An optional title for the notification.

target.name: Target
target.description: Who or what to notify - people, mobile devices, media players, chimes, areas, or other target entities. Leave blank to use the default/implicit deliveries.

custom_target.name: Custom Targets
custom_target.description: Targets outside of Home Assistant, such as e-mail addresses, phone numbers, Slack ids etc.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Used to enable/disable deliveries and scenarios, and mapped to the underlying transport's own priority/urgency flag where supported (e.g. mobile push, SMTP, Telegram, Gotify, ntfy).

delivery_selection.name: Delivery Selection
delivery_selection.description: How the Delivery list and/or Delivery Control data is used - explicit (ignore implicit deliveries), implicit (use these in addition to the implicit deliveries), or fixed (only use these, ignoring any conditional logic to select deliveries).

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.description: Use only these deliveries, as well as any a scenario turns on. Starts with the deliveries used by default, to add to or take away from. Leave out to choose automatically.

require_scenarios.name: Required Scenarios
require_scenarios.description: Suppress this notification unless at least one of these scenarios is currently active.

apply_scenarios.name: Apply Scenarios
apply_scenarios.description: Force these scenarios to be treated as active for this notification, regardless of their own conditions.

constrain_scenarios.name: Constrained Scenarios
constrain_scenarios.description: Only let these scenarios (plus any in Apply Scenarios) affect this notification, ignoring any other active scenario.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: A camera to snapshot (and PTZ move first, if configured) before delivery.

snapshot_url.name: Snapshot URL
snapshot_url.description: A pre-existing image URL to attach, instead of triggering a new camera snapshot.

clip_url.name: Clip URL
clip_url.description: A pre-existing video clip URL to attach.

media.name: Other Media Options
media.description: Advanced media options not covered by the fields above, e.g. PTZ preset, capture delay, or image format overrides.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: One-off actionable-notification buttons to attach, without needing a pre-configured action group.

action_groups.name: Action Groups
action_groups.description: Named groups of mobile actionable-notification buttons to attach, as configured under action_groups:.

message_html.name: HTML Message
message_html.description: An HTML alternative to Message, used by transports that support rich formatting (e.g. e-mail).

spoken_message.name: Spoken Message
spoken_message.description: A spoken alternative to Message, used by transports that speak it aloud (e.g. Alexa, TTS).

debug.name: Debug
debug.description: Include extra diagnostic detail for this notification in traces and the archive.

force_resend.name: Force Resend
force_resend.description: Send even if duplicate-detection would otherwise suppress this notification.

data.name: Data (legacy)
data.description: Older name for Extra Data, kept so existing automations still show in the visual editor. Use Extra Data for new automations.

timestamp.name: Timestamp Format
timestamp.description: Append the current date/time to the message, in square brackets, using a Python strftime format such as %H:%M or %Y-%m-%d %H:%M.

extra_data.name: Extra Data
extra_data.description: Passthrough data and transport tuning for transports/blueprints that expect their own fields here, e.g. attributes from a Frigate notification blueprint.

delivery_control.name: Delivery Control
delivery_control.description: Delivery names, a list of them, or a mapping to tune each delivery, as delivery: would be written in YAML. Merged with the deliveries chosen above, and a delivery given in both takes its form from here.

multimedia.name: Multimedia
multimedia.description: Attach a camera snapshot, an existing image, or a video clip to this notification.

scenarios.name: Scenarios
scenarios.description: Require, force-apply, or constrain which scenarios affect this notification.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Actionable-notification buttons, HTML formatting, debug tracing, and other less commonly used options.

enquire_configuration.name: Enquire Configuration
enquire_configuration.description: Debugging assistant to show the currently loaded SuperNotify configuration

enquire_deliveries_by_scenario.name: Enquire Deliveries By Scenario
enquire_deliveries_by_scenario.description: Debugging assistant to show list of deliveries for each scenario, including default usage

enquire_implicit_deliveries.name: Enquire Implicit Deliveries
enquire_implicit_deliveries.description: Debugging assistant to show the deliveries used automatically by default for each transport

enquire_last_notification.name: Enquire Last Notification
enquire_last_notification.description: Debugging assistant to show the contents of the last notification sent

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Include the fuller diagnostics-level detail rather than just a summary

enquire_recipients.name: Enquire Recipients
enquire_recipients.description: Debugging assistant to show the currently configured recipients

enquire_scenarios.name: Enquire Scenarios
enquire_scenarios.description: Debugging assistant to show the currently configured scenarios and their attributes

enquire_active_scenarios.name: Enquire Active Scenarios
enquire_active_scenarios.description: Debugging assistant to show which scenarios are currently active

trace.name: Trace
trace.description: Include the condition evaluation trace for each active scenario

enquire_occupancy.name: Enquire Occupancy
enquire_occupancy.description: Debugging assistant to show the current occupancy status used for delivery targeting

enquire_snoozes.name: Enquire Snoozes
enquire_snoozes.description: Debugging assistant to show the currently active snoozes

refresh_entities.name: Refresh Entities
refresh_entities.description: Refresh every entity SuperNotify exposes for introspection and control

reset_overrides.name: Reset Overrides
reset_overrides.description: Put every scenario, recipient, delivery and transport switched on or off at runtime back to its configured state

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Only reset this kind of switch - every kind if not given

purge_media.name: Purge Media
purge_media.description: Delete stored media files older than the configured (or given) number of days

days.name: Days
days.description: Override the configured retention period for this purge, in days

purge_archive.name: Purge Archive
purge_archive.description: Delete archived notification records older than the configured (or given) number of days

days.name: Days
days.description: Override the configured retention period for this purge, in days

enquire_archive.name: Enquire archive
enquire_archive.description: Return archived notifications. Without 'id' returns a list (newest first); with 'id' returns one notification's full detail.

id.name: Notification id
id.description: Return the full detail of this one notification.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of notifications to return (default 20, max 100).

after.name: After
after.description: Return only notifications created after this date/time.

before.name: Before
before.description: Return only notifications created before this date/time.

outcome.name: Outcome
outcome.description: Return only notifications with this outcome.

llm_tools.title: Assist and AI agents
llm_tools.description: Beta: let Assist use Supernotify. The tools are for conversation agents that use an AI model, and AI agents connected through Home Assistant's MCP server, and only reach the recipients, deliveries and scenarios already configured. The built-in agent, which doesn't use AI, can't use them, but can understand a few English sentences instead.

data_description.action_tools: Send notifications, and snooze or silence them
data_description.diagnostic_tools: Explain recent notifications, dry-run who a notification would reach, list snoozes, and look up the Supernotify documentation online
data_description.sentence_commands: English sentences for the built-in agent, such as 'tell Alice that dinner is ready' or 'snooze my notifications for 30 minutes'

data_description.default_inclusion: Control how Deliveries are considered for inclusion in notifications
data_description.voice_occupancy: Limit when spoken deliveries, such as TTS or Alexa Devices, are considered for notifications, based on home occupancy

legacy_yaml_config.title: Supernotify YAML configuration needs to move

confirm.title: Migrate Supernotify YAML configuration
confirm.description:
Delivery, transports, scenarios, recipients, cameras, action groups, links and snooze settings need to move out of the `notify: - platform: supernotify` YAML block into a new top-level `supernotify:` key instead.

Selecting **Submit** automates this: it writes a new `supernotify.yaml` file containing your current settings, and adds a `supernotify: !include supernotify.yaml` line to the end of your `configuration.yaml`. Your configuration is reloaded immediately - no restart needed.

**Prefer to do it by hand instead?** Just move the settings to a top-level `supernotify:` key yourself instead of clicking Submit - either way is fine, and this repair doesn't need you to come back and confirm it.

Either way, this does **not** remove the old `notify: - platform: supernotify` block itself. Once that block is deleted from `configuration.yaml` and Home Assistant is restarted, this repair clears itself automatically - no need to dismiss it manually.

already_migrated.title: Supernotify YAML configuration already migrated
already_migrated.description: `supernotify.yaml` and the `supernotify:` include already exist - this leftover `notify: - platform: supernotify` block in your YAML is now unused and can be removed. Selecting **Submit** dismisses this reminder.

error.supernotify_yaml_exists: A supernotify.yaml file already exists - remove or rename it first, then try again
error.supernotify_key_exists: configuration.yaml already has a top-level `supernotify:` key - merge your settings into it by hand instead
error.migrated_config_invalid: The current delivery/transports/scenarios/recipients/cameras/action_groups/links/snooze configuration doesn't pass validation - check the Home Assistant log for details
error.write_failed: Writing the new configuration files failed - check the Home Assistant log for details
error.validation_failed: The updated configuration.yaml failed validation, so nothing was changed - check the Home Assistant log for details

legacy_yaml_manual_migration_required.title: Supernotify YAML configuration must be migrated manually
legacy_yaml_manual_migration_required.description: The automated migration to a top-level `supernotify:` YAML key could not complete: {reason}. Move delivery, transports, scenarios, recipients, cameras, action groups, links and snooze settings out of the `notify: - platform: supernotify` block into a top-level `supernotify:` key yourself (for example `supernotify: !include supernotify.yaml`), then remove the old block and restart Home Assistant.

recipient_binary_sensor_deprecated.title: Recipient binary sensors will be removed
recipient_binary_sensor_deprecated.description: Each recipient now has a switch (for example `switch.supernotify_recipient_XXXX`) that enables and disables it. The recipient `binary_sensor` entities are read-only from now on, only mirroring whether the recipient is enabled, and will be removed in a future version. Writing the state of a recipient `binary_sensor` no longer enables or disables the recipient, so change any automation, script or dashboard that does that, or otherwise relies on these entities, to use the recipient switch instead.

delivery_transport_binary_sensor_depreca.title: Delivery and transport binary sensors will be removed
delivery_transport_binary_sensor_depreca.description: Each delivery and transport now has a switch (for example `switch.supernotify_delivery_XXXX` or `switch.supernotify_transport_XXXX`) that enables and disables it. The delivery and transport `binary_sensor` entities are read-only from now on, only mirroring whether the delivery or transport is enabled, and will be removed in a future version. Writing the state of one of these `binary_sensor` entities no longer enables or disables the delivery or transport, so change any automation, script or dashboard that does that, or otherwise relies on these entities, to use the switch instead.
